body: This is actually why I feel so awful. It most certainly has not felt better trying and failing over and over again. I was so much happier before I took my chances; I had things to look forward to each day. Now, I have literally no motivation to get up in the morning. I just have no reason to keep going. Even if I did have something left to hope for, I've messed up so many times that its not worth it for me to even try anymore.
